plugin.name: Book
plugin.description: Bind pages into a book: a cover, contents, preface, body pages and appendices. The contents reads the book through, numbers it and prints it to a file.
field.placeholder: Write here. Footnotes: text[^1] and a line [^1]: the note. Captions: a line Figure: … under an image, Table: … above a table. Equations: a line Equation: under an embedded formula.
field.subtitle: Subtitle
cover.titleIs: The title is the book's name: {name}
cover.alone: This cover is not in a book.
cover.empty: No cover image or text yet.
toc.alone: These contents are not in any book.
toc.empty: Drag body pages, notes or anything else under this book.
book.noToc: This book has no contents yet: make one under it to read it through.
place.hasCover: This book already has a cover.
place.hasOne: This book already has one of these.
appendix.alone: This appendix is not in a book.
export.pickFolder: Choose a folder to export to, then export again.
book.unsaved: Save the book: it then gets a cover and contents.
field.title: Title
references.alone: These references are not in a book.
references.empty: No entries cited yet. Make entries under this page; their names are the citation keys, written in the text as [@key].
index.alone: This index is not in a book.
index.empty: No index terms yet. Mark them in the text as {{index:term}} or {{index:main/sub}}.
figures.alone: This list is not in a book.
figures.empty: No captioned figures or tables yet.
figures.column.caption: Caption
field.split.hint: Pages meant for teachers (such as answer appendices) go only into the teacher's edition.
colophon.alone: A colophon belongs in a book: put it into one.
colophon.copyStudent: Edition {edition}, printing {printing} (student's edition) — a read-only copy.
colophon.copyTeacher: Edition {edition}, printing {printing} (teacher's edition) — a read-only copy.
colophon.never: Not published yet. “Publish new edition” makes edition 1.
colophon.noFile: That file is no longer there.
ai.tool.contents: A book's contents in reading order: each item's number, name, level, id, type and role (what the page is for), the pages outside the reading order, and what each role means. Start here before reading or proposing changes.
ai.tool.page: One page as it stands in its book: its number, role, outline (headings, captions, index terms, citations), its text as written, and what readers see.
ai.tool.refs: Every cross reference, citation and index term of a book, and which ones are broken.
ai.role.book: A book (or a volume in it): binds the pages below it.
ai.role.cover: The cover: title and author; not part of the reading order.
ai.role.toc: The contents page: made from the book itself; do not change it to change the contents.
ai.role.preface: A preface: text before the body, not numbered.
ai.role.body: A body page: the book's text, numbered by its place; its text may be changed.
ai.role.group: A part or chapter that holds pages; numbered by its place.
ai.role.afterword: An afterword: text after the body, not numbered.
ai.role.references: The list of references: made from its entries; citations point to entries by key.
ai.role.reference: One reference entry: its name is the citation key.
ai.role.index: The index: made from the terms marked in the text.
ai.role.figures: The list of figures and tables: made from the captions.
ai.role.colophon: The colophon: edition and printing records; kept as published.
ai.role.other: A page another plugin provides; read it with read before proposing changes.
ai.how: Read the conventions (if any) and the contents first, then pages as needed (book_page, read). Whatever you write or change must keep to the conventions. To change anything, use propose: one proposal per piece of work, saying what and why; nothing is written until the user accepts it.
ai.notABook: That is not a book (or not one you may see).
ai.noPage: That page is not there (or not one you may see).
conv.parts: Front matter: {front}. Body: {chapters} chapters. Back matter: {back}.
conv.numbering: Chapters are numbered “{first}”, sections “{second}”, deeper levels “{deep}”; appendices “{appendix}”; figures and tables by chapter: “{figure}”.
conv.numbering.none: Chapters and sections are not numbered.
conv.cite.numeric: Citations are numbered in the order first cited (GB/T 7714).
conv.alone: Conventions belong in a book: put this page in one.
conv.skeleton:
1. Arrangement: …

2. Words: the table below says which words this book uses.

3. Symbols: the table below says what each symbol means.
conv.noTerms: The table of words is empty: there is nothing to check.
conv.found: {count} places on {pages} pages do not keep to the conventions.
conv.fixTitle: Use the words the conventions say
conv.fixComment: Words replaced as the conventions say:
ai.tool.check: The places in a book that use a word its conventions say not to use: page, line, passage, the word and what to use. Propose changes for them with propose.
ai.role.conventions: The conventions: how this book is written — its arrangement, the words to use, the symbols. Read it first; keep to it when writing or proposing changes.
